options.how: A pure rhythm game: repeat each rap master's lines with button presses timed to the music; timing is the whole game.
A roguelike dungeon crawl where you move and attack only on the beat while enemies follow their own rhythmic patterns.

sources.note: PaRappa the Rapper: the original rhythm game, learning from rap masters
Crypt of the NecroDancer: roguelike rhythm game, move on the beat

options.how: One button: press the spacebar on the 7th beat to defibrillate patients; levels test polyrhythms and irregular meters.
A character action game whose characters, world and combat sync to the music; you fight to the beat of the track.

sources.note: Rhythm Doctor: slam the spacebar on the 7th beat, polyrhythms and irregular meters
Hi-Fi Rush: action game where characters, world and combat sync to the music

options.how: Slash incoming notes with VR sabers matching color and direction; every level is handcrafted to its song.
A roguelike FPS where all your actions and enemy attacks are tied to the beat of the music.

sources.note: Beat Saber: match the color and direction of incoming notes, levels handcrafted to the music
BPM: Bullets Per Minute: all actions of player and enemies tied to the beat

options.how: Tap in time with notes as your runner dashes through a parkour-style stage; the chart is the level.
A rhythm FPS: shooting on the beat matters, and the more in sync you are, the more intense the soundtrack gets.

sources.note: Muse Dash: parkour rhythm game, hitting to music
Metal: Hellsinger: rhythm FPS, shoot on the beat to intensify the music

options.how: Click hit circles exactly when the shrinking approach circle meets their border; maps are charted to songs.
A Zelda adventure where every beat is a chance to move, attack or defend; enemies follow rhythmic patterns.

sources.note: osu!: official wiki, tap hit circles when the approach circle reaches their border
Cadence of Hyrule: every beat is a chance to move, attack and defend

options.how: Drum along to songs from start to finish, hitting scrolling notes in time across four difficulty modes.
Command an army by drumming rhythmic sequences on four drums; each beat pattern is an order to your Patapon squad.

sources.note: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival: drum along to songs, 4 difficulty modes
Patapon: use the rhythm of 4 drums to command Patapons

options.how: Spin, flick and tap a turntable-like track to match colors and beats on hand-made charts.
A falling-block puzzle where a BPM-synced bar sweeps completed squares away each measure, so tempo sets the pace.

sources.note: Spin Rhythm XD: spin, flick and tap to match colours and beats
Lumines Remastered: BPM bar sweeps combos clean after each measure

options.how: Rhythm violence: steer down a track and hit or turn through obstacles in time with the music, with simple controls.
A VR on-rails shooter: blast, duck and dodge through scenes while your gunfire builds rhythms with the beat.

sources.note: Thumper: rhythm violence, classic rhythm-action at high speed
Pistol Whip: physical action-rhythm FPS, build rhythms in a ballet of bullets

options.how: A three-lane note highway where every note is a monster with its own pattern, such as bats that shift lanes when hit and tough foes needing several hits.
A co-op looter-shooter dungeon crawler: the closer you time attacks and moves to the soundtrack, the more powerful they become.

sources.note: Rift of the NecroDancer: musical combat on lanes, bats shift lanes when attacked, tougher foes take multiple hits
Soundfall: music-based dungeon crawler looter-shooter, the closer you time actions to the rhythm the more powerful you become

options.how: 20+ hand-drawn dream levels, each introducing a new way to follow the rhythm, with no intimidating overlays: you read the beat from the scene.
1v1 fighting matches: hitting notes on the beat lands normal moves and builds meter, spent on EX and special moves that complicate the rival's track.

sources.note: Melatonin: rhythm game, 20+ levels each introducing a new way to follow the rhythm, no intimidating overlays
God of Rock: rhythm-based gameplay with fighting mechanics, hit notes to build meter, spend it on EX and special moves

options.how: Rhythm play uses only two buttons, one for up and one for down; a story adventure and an arcade mode with modifiers sit around the songs.
A character action brawler: Beat Hits, combos, team-up attacks and specials gain power when synced to the music as you fight hordes.

sources.note: Unbeatable: during rhythm gameplay you only need two buttons, up and down; full arcade mode with modifiers
Hi-Fi Rush: Beat Hits, combos and team-up attacks executed by syncing with the music; defeat hordes keeping time with the beat

options.game: Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Mega Mix
options.how: Press buttons in time across 100+ songs in Arcade Mode, or switch to motion-controlled Mix Mode; the song chart is the whole challenge.
A falling-block puzzle: build single-color squares from 2x2 blocks, and a Timeline sweeping to the beat clears them for points.

sources.note: Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Mega Mix: button-based Arcade Mode or motion-based Mix Mode over 100+ songs
Lumines Arise: manipulate 2x2 blocks to form squares; a Timeline clears squares to the beat of the music

options.how: Push buttons in time to match triggers crossing the screen on three stage types, across 385 Final Fantasy music tracks.
An adventure RPG of roaming and odd encounters where every fight is a music-based battle played out to the track.

sources.note: Theatrhythm Final Bar Line: push buttons in time with the music to match triggers on 3 stage types, 385 tracks
Everhood: unconventional adventure RPG with music based battles

options.how: Honk, blow and toot a trombone through 60+ songs; the only layer beyond playing songs is collecting 50 Tromboner Cards.
A demon-slaying FPS where shooting on the beat boosts your output, and staying in sync makes the metal soundtrack and destruction escalate.

sources.note: Trombone Champ: honk, blow and toot your way through over 60 songs; collect 50 Tromboner Cards
Metal: Hellsinger: rhythm and FPS blend, shooting on the beat enhances play, more in sync means more intense music and destruction

options.how: Handcrafted rhythm-action levels with beatmaps built for original songs: you step and fight to the beat, with a story told between tracks.
A retro-style FPS where you shoot, jump, dodge and reload on the beat, and every enemy action is tied to the music.

sources.note: Rhythm Sprout: handcrafted rhythm action, step to the rhythm and fight to the beat, story mode between levels
BPM: Bullets Per Minute: Rhythm-FPS where all your actions and enemies' actions are tied to the beat, reloading included

options.how: Rhythm-action over 140+ Kingdom Hearts and Disney songs: every input is timed to the chosen track.
A third-person action adventure: you explore Vinyl City and fight musical megastar bosses in rhythm-infused combat with music-based weapons.

sources.note: Kingdom Hearts Melody of Memory: rhythm-action gameplay over 140+ Kingdom Hearts and Disney songs
No Straight Roads: action adventure with rhythm-infused third-person combat against musical megastars
